ThingDef.label: regrowth serum
ThingDef.description: A RimHealth mechanite serum for small repairs. A doctor injects it to regrow one lost nose, ear, finger or toe. The mechanites rebuild the part from the patient's own tissue over two to three days. Anything bigger is beyond them. When the work is done the body absorbs them.\n\nThe patient is in a lot of pain and can't walk until the part is back. The treatment always works.

li.summary: Regrows a lost nose, ear, finger or toe.

ThingDef.label: internal repair serum
ThingDef.description: A RimHealth mechanite serum for old damage inside the body. A doctor injects it into one organ, which can be the brain, the heart, a lung, a kidney, the liver, the stomach or the spine. Over four to six days the mechanites rebuild every scar in that organ. They also repair drug damage like chemical damage in the brain or kidneys and cirrhosis of the liver. When the work is done the body absorbs them.\n\nThe patient can't walk during the treatment. Work on the brain also keeps them unconscious the whole time. A missing organ can't be replaced this way and diseases like dementia stay as they are. The treatment always works.

li.summary: Heals the scars on one organ, the brain included.

ThingDef.label: scar serum
ThingDef.description: A RimHealth mechanite serum for old wounds on the outside of the body. A doctor injects it and picks one scarred body part that isn't an organ, like an arm, a leg, the torso or the ribs. The mechanites smooth out every scar on that part over one to two days, so the old pain goes away. Ritual scars are healed as well. Organs need the internal repair serum instead. When the work is done the body absorbs the mechanites.\n\nThe patient can't walk during the treatment. It always works.

li.summary: Heals the scars on one body part that isn't an organ.

ThingDef.label: mechanite flush
ThingDef.description: A RimHealth serum of hunter mechanites. They track down fibrous and sensory mechanites and break them apart. The fight causes a fever for one to two days and the patient can't walk in that time. Afterwards the body absorbs what is left. The treatment always works.

ThingDef.label: withdrawal serum
ThingDef.description: A RimHealth mechanite serum against drug addiction. The mechanites rewire the brain's reward system and clear out every addiction and tolerance. Luciferium is the one exception because the body needs it too much. Instead of weeks of withdrawal the patient spends three to four days in bed. Afterwards the body absorbs the mechanites. The treatment always works.

li.summary: Ends every drug addiction except luciferium.

ThingDef.label: geriatric serum
ThingDef.description: A RimHealth mechanite serum against the illnesses of old age. Each dose cures one chronic condition and goes for the most dangerous one first. Artery blockage comes before Alzheimer's, then dementia, frailty, bad back, asthma, cataracts and hearing loss. The treatment takes four to six days in bed. Afterwards the body absorbs the mechanites. It always works, but it doesn't make anyone younger.

li.summary: Cures one chronic illness of old age.

ThingDef.label: immunity booster
ThingDef.description: A RimHealth autoinjector that pushes the immune system hard for five days. Immunity against infections, flu and plague builds up half again as fast. It makes most people a bit sick to the stomach. Anyone can inject it themselves. A doctor can also give it through the Operations list.

li.summary: Faster immunity against infections for five days.

ThingDef.label: rejuvenation serum
ThingDef.description: RimHealth's rarest serum. Its mechanites renew cells all over the body and turn back the biological clock by three to eight years. It never takes anyone below 18. The year range and the age limit can be changed in the mod settings. The treatment takes about a week in bed and hurts. Afterwards the body absorbs the mechanites. It always works.

li.summary: Takes three to eight years off the biological age.

HediffDef.label: regrowing
HediffDef.description: Mechanites from a regrowth serum are rebuilding a lost body part. It hurts a lot and the patient can't walk until they are done. Afterwards the body absorbs them.

HediffDef.label: internal repair
HediffDef.description: Mechanites from an internal repair serum are rebuilding scarred or damaged tissue in an organ. The patient can't walk until they are done. Afterwards the body absorbs them.

HediffDef.label: brain repair
HediffDef.description: Mechanites from an internal repair serum are rebuilding scarred or damaged tissue in the brain. The patient stays unconscious until they are done. Afterwards the body absorbs them.

HediffDef.label: scar repair
HediffDef.description: Mechanites from a scar serum are smoothing out old scars. The patient can't walk until they are done. Afterwards the body absorbs them.

HediffDef.label: mechanite flush
HediffDef.description: Hunter mechanites are breaking down harmful mechanites. It causes a fever and the patient can't walk until they are done.

HediffDef.label: mechanite detox
HediffDef.description: Mechanites from a withdrawal serum are clearing out drug addictions. The patient feels sick and can't walk until they are done.

HediffDef.label: geriatric treatment
HediffDef.description: Mechanites from a geriatric serum are curing a chronic illness. The patient can't walk until they are done.

HediffDef.label: cell renewal
HediffDef.description: Mechanites from a rejuvenation serum are renewing the body's cells. The patient can't walk until they are done.

HediffDef.label: immunity boost
HediffDef.description: An immunity booster is pushing the immune system. Immunity against infections builds up half again as fast. It upsets the stomach a bit.

HediffDef.label: mechanite itch
HediffDef.description: Leftover mechanites are leaving the body through the skin. The skin itches until they are gone.

HediffDef.label: mechanite headache
HediffDef.description: The mechanites left a dull headache behind. It fades after a day or two.

HediffDef.label: mechanite fatigue
HediffDef.description: The treatment wore the body out. Sleep is needed more often for a few days.

HediffDef.label: cravings
HediffDef.description: The body is restocking what the mechanites used up. Hunger comes back much faster for a while.

HediffDef.label: mechanite residue
HediffDef.description: A few mechanites stayed behind in the nerves. They hurt a little and sharpen the senses until the body breaks them down.

HediffDef.label: grey hair
HediffDef.description: Mechanites bleached the hair grey. The natural color slowly comes back over the following days.

li.label: strange dreams
li.description: I dreamed of glowing machines rebuilding a whole city. Oddly calming.

li.label: strange dreams
li.description: I dreamed tiny machines were crawling under my skin.
